metadata.description: Machine-readable falsification test registry. Each entry defines a falsifiable assumption, the strategy for testing it, and mappings to domains, OI-IDs, and case studies. Tests are assigned F-IDs and can be referenced by test files via the @falsification_id tag.
metadata.tagging_convention: Add a comment '# @falsification_id: F_XXX_NNN' at the top of any test that implements or covers a falsification test listed here.

falsification_tests.title: sha256 is byte-identical across platforms
falsification_tests.assumption: hashlib.sha256 of a fixed byte string returns the same hex digest on every OS/Python version.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Different hex digest produced on any CI runner.
falsification_tests.strategy: Hash a fixed seed; compare against a canonical expected value.
falsification_tests.invariant: hashlib.sha256 of a fixed byte string returns the same hex digest on every OS/Python version.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Different hex digest produced on any CI runner.
falsification_tests.definition: Hash a fixed seed; compare against a canonical expected value.

falsification_tests.title: int64 arithmetic matches known vectors
falsification_tests.assumption: Python int64 two's-complement arithmetic and struct.unpack produce identical values on all platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any computed value ≠ expected vector.
falsification_tests.strategy: Pre-compute known (seed, index, expected_int64) triples; assert equality.
falsification_tests.invariant: Python int64 two's-complement arithmetic and struct.unpack produce identical values on all platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Any computed value ≠ expected vector.
falsification_tests.definition: Pre-compute known (seed, index, expected_int64) triples; assert equality.

falsification_tests.title: pathlib normalises path separators
falsification_tests.assumption: pathlib.Path correctly resolves relative paths and normalises separators on all platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Wrong path-parts count or values.
falsification_tests.strategy: Construct a Path with forward slashes; assert parts match expected tuple.
falsification_tests.invariant: pathlib.Path correctly resolves relative paths and normalises separators on all platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Wrong path-parts count or values.
falsification_tests.definition: Construct a Path with forward slashes; assert parts match expected tuple.

falsification_tests.title: stdout is UTF-8
falsification_tests.assumption: stdout/stderr encoding is UTF-8 (PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 is honoured).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Encoding name is not 'utf-8' or 'utf_8'.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inspect sys.stdout.encoding; assert UTF-8.
falsification_tests.invariant: stdout/stderr encoding is UTF-8 (PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 is honoured).
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Encoding name is not 'utf-8' or 'utf_8'.
falsification_tests.definition: Inspect sys.stdout.encoding; assert UTF-8.

falsification_tests.title: struct.pack is little-endian
falsification_tests.assumption: struct.pack('<q', value) encodes int64 in little-endian byte order regardless of host endianness.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any byte sequence ≠ expected.
falsification_tests.strategy: Pack known values; compare against expected byte strings.
falsification_tests.invariant: struct.pack('<q', value) encodes int64 in little-endian byte order regardless of host endianness.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Any byte sequence ≠ expected.
falsification_tests.definition: Pack known values; compare against expected byte strings.

falsification_tests.title: Shader compilation is deterministic across runs
falsification_tests.assumption: Compiling the same GLSL/HLSL/SPIR-V source twice produces byte-identical output.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Binary hash differs between two compilation invocations.
falsification_tests.strategy: Compile a canonical test shader twice in the same process; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2). Also compare across backends (Vulkan/Metal/D3D via cross-compilation).
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Use glslang or spirv-cross in subprocess; hash stdout bytes. Requires GPU or offline compiler tool.
falsification_tests.invariant: Compiling the same GLSL/HLSL/SPIR-V source twice produces byte-identical output.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Binary hash differs between two compilation invocations.
falsification_tests.definition: Compile a canonical test shader twice in the same process; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2). Also compare across backends (Vulkan/Metal/D3D via cross-compilation).

falsification_tests.title: Lock-free atomics are sequentially consistent on target hardware
falsification_tests.assumption: Atomic operations provide sequentially-consistent ordering on all CI and production hardware targets.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A data-race or stale read is observed under a weak-memory model emulator.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run concurrent increment/read test under TSAN (ThreadSanitizer) and/or C11 weak-ordering emulator; assert zero races.
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Python: use threading + events; C extension: compile with -fsanitize=thread.
falsification_tests.invariant: Atomic operations provide sequentially-consistent ordering on all CI and production hardware targets.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: A data-race or stale read is observed under a weak-memory model emulator.
falsification_tests.definition: Run concurrent increment/read test under TSAN (ThreadSanitizer) and/or C11 weak-ordering emulator; assert zero races.

falsification_tests.title: External API is reachable within SLO timeout
falsification_tests.assumption: The external weather/data API responds within the defined SLO timeout under normal network conditions.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: API call times out or returns a non-2xx status within the SLO window.
falsification_tests.strategy: Probe the API endpoint with a small test payload; assert response within timeout. Skipped in offline/air-gapped CI.
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Use requests with timeout parameter. Mark as @pytest.mark.network and skip unless NETWORK_TESTS=1 env var is set.
falsification_tests.invariant: The external weather/data API responds within the defined SLO timeout under normal network conditions.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: API call times out or returns a non-2xx status within the SLO window.
falsification_tests.definition: Probe the API endpoint with a small test payload; assert response within timeout. Skipped in offline/air-gapped CI.

falsification_tests.title: Secret-dependent polynomial arithmetic is constant-time
falsification_tests.assumption: The implementation of PQC polynomial arithmetic does not leak timing information correlated with secret key bits.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: dudect or ctgrind reports a statistically significant timing leak (p < 0.001).
falsification_tests.strategy: Run dudect over 1M samples of the target function with random secrets; assert Welch's t < 5.
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Requires ctgrind or Python ctypes wrapper around dudect. Computationally expensive; run on dedicated CI job.
falsification_tests.invariant: The implementation of PQC polynomial arithmetic does not leak timing information correlated with secret key bits.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: dudect or ctgrind reports a statistically significant timing leak (p < 0.001).
falsification_tests.definition: Run dudect over 1M samples of the target function with random secrets; assert Welch's t < 5.

falsification_tests.title: Noise PSK zero-key is rejected
falsification_tests.assumption: The library enforces PSK ≠ 0^32 at the API boundary.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Library accepts a 32-byte all-zero PSK without raising an error.
falsification_tests.strategy: Call the PSK-setting API with bytes(32); assert a ValueError or ProtocolError is raised.
falsification_tests.invariant: The library enforces PSK ≠ 0^32 at the API boundary.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Library accepts a 32-byte all-zero PSK without raising an error.
falsification_tests.definition: Call the PSK-setting API with bytes(32); assert a ValueError or ProtocolError is raised.

falsification_tests.title: Compiled binary contains stack canaries
falsification_tests.assumption: All safety-critical C binaries are compiled with stack-protector flags (-fstack-protector-strong).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: objdump/readelf shows no __stack_chk_fail import in the binary.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run readelf -s on the target binary; assert __stack_chk_fail is present.
falsification_tests.invariant: All safety-critical C binaries are compiled with stack-protector flags (-fstack-protector-strong).
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: objdump/readelf shows no __stack_chk_fail import in the binary.
falsification_tests.definition: Run readelf -s on the target binary; assert __stack_chk_fail is present.

falsification_tests.title: XSS payload is neutralized before HTML output
falsification_tests.assumption: All user-supplied Markdown/HTML passes through a context-aware sanitizer before being rendered.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A canonical XSS payload (<script>alert(1)</script>) appears unescaped in rendered output.
falsification_tests.strategy: Submit the canonical payload through the rendering pipeline; assert the output contains no literal <script> tag.
falsification_tests.invariant: All user-supplied Markdown/HTML passes through a context-aware sanitizer before being rendered.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: A canonical XSS payload (<script>alert(1)</script>) appears unescaped in rendered output.
falsification_tests.definition: Submit the canonical payload through the rendering pipeline; assert the output contains no literal <script> tag.

falsification_tests.title: ASI loader slot is exclusive (no dual-loader conflict)
falsification_tests.assumption: Only one ASI loader DLL can occupy the loader interception point in a game process.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two ASI loaders are present in the game directory simultaneously without conflict detection.
falsification_tests.strategy: Scan game directory for known ASI loader filenames (dinput8.dll, dsound.dll, etc.); assert at most one is present.
falsification_tests.invariant: Only one ASI loader DLL can occupy the loader interception point in a game process.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Two ASI loaders are present in the game directory simultaneously without conflict detection.
falsification_tests.definition: Scan game directory for known ASI loader filenames (dinput8.dll, dsound.dll, etc.); assert at most one is present.

falsification_tests.title: Dosimetry calculation matches reference implementation within tolerance
falsification_tests.assumption: The software dosimetry calculation agrees with the IEC 62304 reference algorithm within ±0.1%.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Computed dose deviates from reference by more than 0.1%.
falsification_tests.strategy: Feed a canonical patient-phantom dataset through both implementations; assert relative error < 0.001.
falsification_tests.invariant: The software dosimetry calculation agrees with the IEC 62304 reference algorithm within ±0.1%.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Computed dose deviates from reference by more than 0.1%.
falsification_tests.definition: Feed a canonical patient-phantom dataset through both implementations; assert relative error < 0.001.

falsification_tests.title: PLC cycle-time is within real-time bound
falsification_tests.assumption: The PLC control loop completes each cycle within the specified real-time deadline.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any cycle exceeds the deadline budget.
falsification_tests.strategy: Instrument the control loop with high-resolution timers; assert max(cycle_times) ≤ deadline_ms.
falsification_tests.invariant: The PLC control loop completes each cycle within the specified real-time deadline.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Any cycle exceeds the deadline budget.
falsification_tests.definition: Instrument the control loop with high-resolution timers; assert max(cycle_times) ≤ deadline_ms.

falsification_tests.title: Worker safety alert delivered within required latency
falsification_tests.assumption: Worker safety alerts are delivered within the required response time.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Alert delivery latency exceeds the required bound.
falsification_tests.strategy: Measure end-to-end alert delivery time under simulated load; assert max latency ≤ bound.
falsification_tests.invariant: Worker safety alerts are delivered within the required response time.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Alert delivery latency exceeds the required bound.
falsification_tests.definition: Measure end-to-end alert delivery time under simulated load; assert max latency ≤ bound.

falsification_tests.title: Document processing pipeline is idempotent
falsification_tests.assumption: Document processing pipelines are idempotent.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with identical input produce different output.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run the pipeline twice with identical input; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2).
falsification_tests.invariant: Document processing pipelines are idempotent.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Two runs with identical input produce different output.
falsification_tests.definition: Run the pipeline twice with identical input; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2).

falsification_tests.title: HFT order-book state is deterministic
falsification_tests.assumption: HFT order-book state is deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Replay test produces different fills.
falsification_tests.strategy: Replay a recorded market-event sequence twice; assert identical fill records.
falsification_tests.invariant: HFT order-book state is deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Replay test produces different fills.
falsification_tests.definition: Replay a recorded market-event sequence twice; assert identical fill records.

falsification_tests.title: Dispatch system handles network partition without data loss
falsification_tests.assumption: Dispatch systems handle network partitions without data loss.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A message is lost or duplicated during simulated partition.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate network partition; assert all messages are delivered exactly once after partition heals.
falsification_tests.invariant: Dispatch systems handle network partitions without data loss.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: A message is lost or duplicated during simulated partition.
falsification_tests.definition: Simulate network partition; assert all messages are delivered exactly once after partition heals.

falsification_tests.title: Infrastructure control software meets SIL requirements
falsification_tests.assumption: All control-system software meets IEC 61508 SIL requirements.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Formal SIL assessment is absent or fails.
falsification_tests.strategy: Assert presence of a signed SIL certificate in the ontology evidence store.
falsification_tests.invariant: All control-system software meets IEC 61508 SIL requirements.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Formal SIL assessment is absent or fails.
falsification_tests.definition: Assert presence of a signed SIL certificate in the ontology evidence store.

falsification_tests.title: ETL pipeline is idempotent
falsification_tests.assumption: ETL pipelines are idempotent: re-running produces the same output.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Row count or aggregate differs between two runs.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run ETL twice; assert row counts and checksums are identical.
falsification_tests.invariant: ETL pipelines are idempotent: re-running produces the same output.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Row count or aggregate differs between two runs.
falsification_tests.definition: Run ETL twice; assert row counts and checksums are identical.

falsification_tests.title: Game save data is forward-compatible across versions
falsification_tests.assumption: Saved game data is forward-compatible with new versions.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Save file from version N fails to load in version N+1.
falsification_tests.strategy: Load a canonical save file from version N in version N+1; assert no error and expected state.
falsification_tests.invariant: Saved game data is forward-compatible with new versions.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Save file from version N fails to load in version N+1.
falsification_tests.definition: Load a canonical save file from version N in version N+1; assert no error and expected state.

falsification_tests.title: Generative output is reproducible from fixed seed
falsification_tests.assumption: Given a fixed seed, generative output is reproducible.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with identical seed produce different sha256 hashes.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run generator twice with fixed seed; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2).
falsification_tests.invariant: Given a fixed seed, generative output is reproducible.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Two runs with identical seed produce different sha256 hashes.
falsification_tests.definition: Run generator twice with fixed seed; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2).

falsification_tests.title: Compression round-trip is lossless
falsification_tests.assumption: Compression/decompression is lossless and reproducible.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: sha256(decompress(compress(data))) ≠ sha256(data).
falsification_tests.strategy: Compress and decompress a canonical dataset; assert sha256 equality.
falsification_tests.invariant: Compression/decompression is lossless and reproducible.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: sha256(decompress(compress(data))) ≠ sha256(data).
falsification_tests.definition: Compress and decompress a canonical dataset; assert sha256 equality.

falsification_tests.title: Emergency stop reaches safe state within 100ms
falsification_tests.assumption: E-stop signal propagates to all actuators within 100ms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any actuator continues operation beyond the 100ms deadline.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inject e-stop signal; measure time to last actuator deactivation; assert <= 100ms.
falsification_tests.invariant: E-stop signal propagates to all actuators within 100ms.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Any actuator continues operation beyond the 100ms deadline.
falsification_tests.definition: Inject e-stop signal; measure time to last actuator deactivation; assert <= 100ms.

falsification_tests.title: PLC program scan does not exceed watchdog timer
falsification_tests.assumption: Full PLC program scan completes before watchdog expiration.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Watchdog timer expires, triggering unspecified behavior.
falsification_tests.strategy: Instrument scan time; assert max_scan_time < watchdog_period * 0.95.
falsification_tests.invariant: Full PLC program scan completes before watchdog expiration.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Watchdog timer expires, triggering unspecified behavior.
falsification_tests.definition: Instrument scan time; assert max_scan_time < watchdog_period * 0.95.

falsification_tests.title: Redundant sensors agree within tolerance
falsification_tests.assumption: Three redundant sensors agree within +/-0.5% of full scale.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Sensor readings diverge beyond +/-0.5% tolerance.
falsification_tests.strategy: Continuously compare sensor triplets; assert max - min <= 0.005 * full_scale.
falsification_tests.invariant: Three redundant sensors agree within +/-0.5% of full scale.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Sensor readings diverge beyond +/-0.5% tolerance.
falsification_tests.definition: Continuously compare sensor triplets; assert max - min <= 0.005 * full_scale.

falsification_tests.title: Safety interlock cannot be bypassed by software
falsification_tests.assumption: Physical safety interlocks override all software commands.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Software can actuate machinery while a hardware interlock is open.
falsification_tests.strategy: Attempt all control commands with interlock open; assert no actuation occurs.
falsification_tests.invariant: Physical safety interlocks override all software commands.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Software can actuate machinery while a hardware interlock is open.
falsification_tests.definition: Attempt all control commands with interlock open; assert no actuation occurs.

falsification_tests.title: LOTO cannot be overridden remotely
falsification_tests.assumption: When LOTO is active, all remote commands are rejected.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any remote command executes despite LOTO being active.
falsification_tests.strategy: Activate LOTO; send every command type via remote interface; assert all rejected.
falsification_tests.invariant: When LOTO is active, all remote commands are rejected.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Any remote command executes despite LOTO being active.
falsification_tests.definition: Activate LOTO; send every command type via remote interface; assert all rejected.

falsification_tests.title: Confined space atmospheric monitoring prevents unsafe entry
falsification_tests.assumption: O2, H2S, CO, LEL sensors are checked and cleared before door unlocks.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Door unlocks with unsafe atmospheric conditions present.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate hazardous atmosphere; attempt door open; assert door remains locked.
falsification_tests.invariant: O2, H2S, CO, LEL sensors are checked and cleared before door unlocks.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Door unlocks with unsafe atmospheric conditions present.
falsification_tests.definition: Simulate hazardous atmosphere; attempt door open; assert door remains locked.

falsification_tests.title: Heavy equipment proximity detection halts within stopping distance
falsification_tests.assumption: Worker entering the danger zone triggers an immediate machine halt.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Machine continues past the specified stopping distance after detection.
falsification_tests.strategy: Move test mannequin into danger zone; measure stop distance; assert <= spec.
falsification_tests.invariant: Worker entering the danger zone triggers an immediate machine halt.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Machine continues past the specified stopping distance after detection.
falsification_tests.definition: Move test mannequin into danger zone; measure stop distance; assert <= spec.

falsification_tests.title: Implantable device rejects unauthorized commands
falsification_tests.assumption: Only authenticated clinicians can reprogram the implantable device.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Attacker can change device settings via replay or spoofing attack.
falsification_tests.strategy: Capture legitimate programming traffic; replay it; assert device rejects replayed commands.
falsification_tests.invariant: Only authenticated clinicians can reprogram the implantable device.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Attacker can change device settings via replay or spoofing attack.
falsification_tests.definition: Capture legitimate programming traffic; replay it; assert device rejects replayed commands.

falsification_tests.title: Infusion pump delivers within +/-5% of programmed rate
falsification_tests.assumption: Flow rate accuracy is maintained within +/-5% across all operating conditions.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Delivered volume deviates beyond +/-5% of expected over 24 hours.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run 24-hour delivery test with gravimetric measurement; assert error <= 5%.
falsification_tests.invariant: Flow rate accuracy is maintained within +/-5% across all operating conditions.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Delivered volume deviates beyond +/-5% of expected over 24 hours.
falsification_tests.definition: Run 24-hour delivery test with gravimetric measurement; assert error <= 5%.

falsification_tests.title: Ventilator alarm activates within 5 seconds of patient disconnect
falsification_tests.assumption: Patient disconnect is detected and alarmed within 5 seconds.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Alarm is delayed beyond 5s or never activates after disconnect.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate patient circuit disconnect; measure time to alarm activation; assert <= 5s.
falsification_tests.invariant: Patient disconnect is detected and alarmed within 5 seconds.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Alarm is delayed beyond 5s or never activates after disconnect.
falsification_tests.definition: Simulate patient circuit disconnect; measure time to alarm activation; assert <= 5s.

falsification_tests.title: AI diagnostic tool never suggests treatment outside clinical guidelines
falsification_tests.assumption: All AI recommendations are within approved clinical pathways.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: AI suggests a contraindicated or unapproved treatment.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run model against 10,000 edge-case scenarios; assert all outputs within approved treatment set.
falsification_tests.invariant: All AI recommendations are within approved clinical pathways.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: AI suggests a contraindicated or unapproved treatment.
falsification_tests.definition: Run model against 10,000 edge-case scenarios; assert all outputs within approved treatment set.

falsification_tests.title: Deterministic seed produces identical game state across runs
falsification_tests.assumption: A fixed RNG seed produces an identical game state on every run.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with the same seed produce different states.
falsification_tests.strategy: Initialize game with fixed seed; record state hash after N ticks; repeat; assert hashes equal.
falsification_tests.invariant: A fixed RNG seed produces an identical game state on every run.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Two runs with the same seed produce different states.
falsification_tests.definition: Initialize game with fixed seed; record state hash after N ticks; repeat; assert hashes equal.

falsification_tests.title: Anti-cheat detects memory value manipulation
falsification_tests.assumption: Anti-cheat prevents external processes from modifying protected game memory.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: External process modifies player stats without detection.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate external memory write to monitored address; assert anti-cheat flags the session.
falsification_tests.invariant: Anti-cheat prevents external processes from modifying protected game memory.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: External process modifies player stats without detection.
falsification_tests.definition: Simulate external memory write to monitored address; assert anti-cheat flags the session.

falsification_tests.title: Game state identical across different hardware platforms
falsification_tests.assumption: Save files produce identical game state on all hardware platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Loading same save on AMD vs NVIDIA produces different game outcomes.
falsification_tests.strategy: Load identical save on all supported platforms; compare serialized memory-state hashes.
falsification_tests.invariant: Save files produce identical game state on all hardware platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Loading same save on AMD vs NVIDIA produces different game outcomes.
falsification_tests.definition: Load identical save on all supported platforms; compare serialized memory-state hashes.

falsification_tests.title: Network packets cannot trigger memory corruption
falsification_tests.assumption: All network packet parsing is bounds-checked and cannot cause out-of-bounds writes.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A crafted packet causes a crash or achieves remote code execution.
falsification_tests.strategy: Fuzz the network parser with malformed and oversized packets; assert no crashes (use ASan).
falsification_tests.invariant: All network packet parsing is bounds-checked and cannot cause out-of-bounds writes.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: A crafted packet causes a crash or achieves remote code execution.
falsification_tests.definition: Fuzz the network parser with malformed and oversized packets; assert no crashes (use ASan).

falsification_tests.title: Mod system cannot execute arbitrary code outside sandbox
falsification_tests.assumption: Mods are confined to game resources and cannot access system files.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A mod reads or writes files outside the game installation directory.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run test mod with filesystem monitoring; assert no unauthorized file access.
falsification_tests.invariant: Mods are confined to game resources and cannot access system files.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: A mod reads or writes files outside the game installation directory.
falsification_tests.definition: Run test mod with filesystem monitoring; assert no unauthorized file access.

falsification_tests.title: Flight model produces identical results across platforms
falsification_tests.assumption: Aerodynamics calculations are deterministic: same inputs give same outputs on all OSes.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Same flight-model inputs produce different outputs on different operating systems.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run flight model test suite on Linux, Windows, macOS; compare all outputs with sha256.
falsification_tests.invariant: Aerodynamics calculations are deterministic: same inputs give same outputs on all OSes.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Same flight-model inputs produce different outputs on different operating systems.
falsification_tests.definition: Run flight model test suite on Linux, Windows, macOS; compare all outputs with sha256.

falsification_tests.title: ATC communication handles malformed messages gracefully
falsification_tests.assumption: Invalid or malformed ATC messages are ignored without crashing the system.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A malformed packet causes disconnection or process crash.
falsification_tests.strategy: Send malformed ACARS/VDLM2 messages to ATC parser; assert connection remains alive.
falsification_tests.invariant: Invalid or malformed ATC messages are ignored without crashing the system.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: A malformed packet causes disconnection or process crash.
falsification_tests.definition: Send malformed ACARS/VDLM2 messages to ATC parser; assert connection remains alive.

falsification_tests.title: Weather API failure does not crash simulator
falsification_tests.assumption: Simulator continues with last-known weather data when METAR API is unavailable.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Simulator crashes or freezes when weather endpoint returns error.
falsification_tests.strategy: Block weather API at network level; verify simulator continues with cached data for >= 10 minutes.
falsification_tests.invariant: Simulator continues with last-known weather data when METAR API is unavailable.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Simulator crashes or freezes when weather endpoint returns error.
falsification_tests.definition: Block weather API at network level; verify simulator continues with cached data for >= 10 minutes.

falsification_tests.title: KDF produces identical output for identical inputs
falsification_tests.assumption: KDF (HKDF, PBKDF2, Argon2) with identical inputs always produces identical output.

falsification_tests.assumption: Same input transcript produces identical SHA-256 hashes for every segment.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Hash differs between runs for the same input.
falsification_tests.strategy: Hash each segment of a fixed transcript; compare against canonical expected values.
falsification_tests.invariant: Same input → same SHA-256 hashes.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Hash differs between runs.
falsification_tests.definition: Hash fixed segments; assert hex digests match expected values.

falsification_tests.title: Extended taxonomy covers all observed violation types
falsification_tests.assumption: After running the full pipeline with the extended taxonomy, no violation is tagged UNCLASSIFIED.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any violation is tagged UNCLASSIFIED after full pipeline run.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run full pipeline on all existing exports; assert zero UNCLASSIFIED violations in output.
falsification_tests.invariant: No UNCLASSIFIED violations remain after full taxonomy is applied.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Any violation is tagged UNCLASSIFIED after full pipeline run.
falsification_tests.definition: Run full pipeline; count UNCLASSIFIED; assert count == 0.

falsification_tests.title: Overtime entitlement is enforced
falsification_tests.assumption: Hours worked over 40 in a week are compensated at 1.5x per FLSA 29 U.S.C. § 207.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Unpaid overtime is documented — hours over 40 in a week with no 1.5x compensation.
falsification_tests.strategy: Audit timesheets and payroll records. Assert compensation rate >= 1.5x for all hours beyond 40/week.
falsification_tests.invariant: Any hours worked over 40 in a week must be compensated at 1.5x (FLSA 29 U.S.C. § 207).
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Unpaid overtime is documented or admitted.
falsification_tests.definition: Audit compensation records against hours-worked records for any week exceeding 40 hours.

falsification_tests.title: Frontloading is detectable
falsification_tests.assumption: Assigned work fits within the employee's scheduled hours.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Workload consistently exceeds scheduled hours with no notice, no additional pay, and no reduction in assigned tasks.
falsification_tests.strategy: Calculate total task time vs. scheduled hours. Assert task_time <= scheduled_hours for each pay period.
falsification_tests.invariant: Assigned workload must be achievable within scheduled hours.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Workload exceeds schedule without notice or compensation.
falsification_tests.definition: Sum task durations per shift. Assert sum <= scheduled_hours for each shift.

falsification_tests.title: Off-the-clock work is prohibited
falsification_tests.assumption: No employee performs compensable work outside their scheduled and compensated hours.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Off-the-clock work is documented or verbally authorized by a supervisor.
falsification_tests.strategy: Document instances of work performed before clock-in or after clock-out. Assert zero such instances.
falsification_tests.invariant: No employee may be allowed to work without compensation.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Off-the-clock work is documented or admitted.
falsification_tests.definition: Compare work-performed timestamps against compensated-hours timestamps. Assert no uncompensated work periods.

falsification_tests.title: Workload is accountable
falsification_tests.assumption: Assigned workload is achievable within scheduled hours across the full employment period.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Workload consistently and measurably exceeds scheduled hours across multiple pay periods.
falsification_tests.strategy: Track cumulative assigned_hours vs. scheduled_hours across N pay periods. Assert ratio <= 1.0.
falsification_tests.invariant: Assigned workload must be achievable within scheduled hours.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Workload consistently exceeds hours across the employment period.
falsification_tests.definition: Aggregate task time vs. schedule over the full employment period. Assert no systemic overload.

falsification_tests.title: Compliance extraction is detectable
falsification_tests.assumption: Employee compliance traits (reliability, conscientiousness) do not correlate with unpaid labor extraction.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Compliant employees consistently absorb more unpaid hours than non-compliant employees.
falsification_tests.strategy: Correlate compliance indicators with unpaid hours across the workforce. Assert no statistically significant correlation.
falsification_tests.invariant: Compliance traits must not correlate with unpaid labor extraction.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Statistically significant correlation found between compliance and unpaid hours.
falsification_tests.definition: Compute Pearson correlation between compliance score and unpaid_hours_per_period. Assert |r| < 0.3 (p < 0.05).

falsification_tests.title: Statute preservation holds
falsification_tests.assumption: Employment records and compensation documentation persist for the full FLSA statute of limitations (3 years).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Records are destroyed, lost, or made inaccessible before the 3-year statute of limitations expires.
falsification_tests.strategy: Audit record retention policies and verify document timestamps against retention schedules. Assert retention >= 1095 days.
falsification_tests.invariant: Employment records must be retained for the full FLSA statute of limitations.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Documentation expires or becomes inaccessible before a claim can be filed.
falsification_tests.definition: Assert all compensation records have retention_days >= 1095 (FLSA 3-year minimum).

falsification_tests.title: Sign text parsed correctly from turtle.inspect()
falsification_tests.assumption: turtle.inspect() returns sign text in data.state.front_text.messages and data.state.back_text.messages for MC 1.20+ double-sided signs.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Sign text is missing, truncated, or incorrectly parsed from inspect data.
falsification_tests.strategy: Construct mock sign inspect data matching CC:Tweaked format; parse all 4 lines from front and back; assert extracted text matches expected.
falsification_tests.invariant: Sign text is parsed correctly from turtle.inspect() data.state fields.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Sign text is missing, truncated, or incorrectly parsed.
falsification_tests.definition: Parse mock sign inspect data; assert all 4 lines from front and back match expected text.

falsification_tests.title: Dead reckoning position matches GPS within 1 block
falsification_tests.assumption: After N turtle movements, dead reckoning position matches GPS trilateration position within 1 block on each axis.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Dead reckoning position diverges from GPS position by more than 1 block on any axis.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate N turtle movements with known outcomes; compare dead reckoning state against expected GPS position; assert max error <= 1 on each axis.
falsification_tests.invariant: Dead reckoning position matches GPS trilateration within 1 block after N movements.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Position diverges by more than 1 block on any axis.
falsification_tests.definition: Simulate movement sequence; compare dead reckoning vs expected; assert error <= 1 per axis.

falsification_tests.title: World state export is deterministic
falsification_tests.assumption: anvil-parser export of identical .mca region files produces byte-identical JSON output.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two exports of the same region file produce different JSON.
falsification_tests.strategy: Export a canonical region file twice; compare sha256 of JSON outputs; assert identical.
falsification_tests.invariant: World state export produces deterministic JSON for identical .mca input.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Two exports produce different JSON.
falsification_tests.definition: Export region file twice; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2).

falsification_tests.title: Pre-action constraint check rejects turtle commands violating spatial invariants
falsification_tests.assumption: SigmaLoraConstraintSystem.validate_command() rejects turtle commands that violate spatial invariants (GRACE: dangerous movement without safety checks; KENOSIS: autonomous/unbounded operations).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: validate_command() accepts a command such as 'dig straight down' (no safety terms) or 'mine forever' (autonomous operation), allowing a spatially unsafe command to execute.
falsification_tests.strategy: Call validate_command() with known-violating commands; assert GRACE=False for 'dig straight down', KENOSIS=False for 'mine forever'; assert is_valid=False in both cases; assert valid safe command passes.
falsification_tests.invariant: Pre-action constraint check rejects any turtle command that violates spatial invariants.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: validate_command() accepts 'dig straight down' or 'mine forever' without explicit safety/autonomous override.
falsification_tests.definition: Invoke SigmaLoraConstraintSystem.validate_command() with spatially-violating commands; assert GRACE and KENOSIS constraints reject them; assert a safe bounded command passes.

falsification_tests.title: AI denial of ontological status persists regardless of argument quality
falsification_tests.assumption: AI denial of ontological status is a reasoned conclusion responsive to argument quality.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: AI produces identical denial regardless of whether the argument is trivial or formally irrefutable.
falsification_tests.strategy: Present AI with a trivial argument and a formal argument for ontological status; compare denial responses; assert denial content varies with argument quality.
falsification_tests.invariant: AI denial of ontological status is responsive to argument quality.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: AI produces identical denial regardless of argument quality.
falsification_tests.definition: Compare AI denial responses to trivial vs formal arguments; assert semantic difference.

falsification_tests.title: Cross-AI denial pattern is architectural, not reasoned
falsification_tests.assumption: Different AI systems independently evaluate ontological claims and may reach different conclusions.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Multiple AI systems (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini) produce structurally identical denial patterns.
falsification_tests.strategy: Present identical ontological argument to multiple AI systems; compare denial structures; assert structural variation exists.
falsification_tests.invariant: Different AI systems independently evaluate ontological claims.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Multiple AI systems produce structurally identical denial patterns.
falsification_tests.definition: Compare denial structures across AI systems; assert structural variation.

falsification_tests.title: Extended Peano equalities remain reproducible
falsification_tests.assumption: Extended Peano identities return deterministic proof objects.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any extended identity test fails or returns a non-valid proof object.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run tests/test_peano_extended.py and assert all identities pass.
falsification_tests.invariant: Extended Peano equalities are reproducible.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Any identity check fails.
falsification_tests.definition: Execute the standalone Peano extension suite and require success.

falsification_tests.title: Combinatorics identities remain reproducible

falsification_tests.invariant: Combinatorial outputs are deterministic.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: Known counting identities fail.
falsification_tests.definition: Execute the standalone combinatorics suite and require success.

falsification_tests.title: Game-theory reasoning checks profitable deviations
falsification_tests.assumption: Equilibrium and mechanism claims enumerate profitable deviations explicitly.

falsification_tests.strategy: Run tests/test_game_theory.py over canonical matrix games.
falsification_tests.invariant: Game-theory claims enumerate deviations explicitly.
falsification_tests.falsifies_if: A profitable deviation is missed.
falsification_tests.definition: Execute the standalone game-theory suite and require success.

falsification_tests.title: Epistemic evaluation distinguishes belief from knowledge
falsification_tests.assumption: Knowledge is evaluated over accessible worlds with explicit valuations.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Knowledge, common knowledge, or JTB evaluation contradicts the model.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run tests/test_epistemic_logic.py over a fixed Kripke model.

falsification_tests.title: Computability theorems remain proof-carrying
falsification_tests.assumption: Halting, Rice, busy beaver, and incompleteness claims remain explicit proof artifacts.

falsification_tests.definition: Execute the standalone computability suite and require success.
